name: tw-lvr-cli
description: TW Property Price CLI (台灣實價登錄 CLI) — Taiwan property transaction prices from 內政部實價登錄 as clean JSON/CSV. Deterministic CLI + library + Agent Skill, packaged as a Claude/Codex-compatible plugin. No server, no model in the loop. Requires the chrome-headless-shell browser binary (npx playwright install chromium-headless-shell).
